statement: A gate lane does not go red because a package mirror timed out once: ast-grep and uv come from the CI cache when it holds the pinned version and are otherwise installed with up to three tries (.github/scripts/retry.sh, setup-ast-grep.sh), and the pins stay the workflow's only copy.
source: coordinator 10-01 08:36 (the bun test lane died in setup on an ast-grep download timeout)

killers.name: R-GATE-CI-SETUP-RETRY a command that fails once and then works is run twice and passes
R-GATE-CI-SETUP-RETRY a command that always fails is run three times, then fails and says so
R-GATE-CI-SETUP-RETRY a command that works is run once
R-GATE-CI-SETUP-RETRY what the cache restored is used: the pinned ast-grep answers offline, so nothing is installed
R-GATE-CI-SETUP-RETRY with nothing cached, uv and then ast-grep are installed at their pins and the result is checked
R-GATE-CI-SETUP-RETRY a download that times out once is retried, and the lane stays green
R-GATE-CI-SETUP-RETRY a download that never works fails the step after three tries, and the check at the end does not run
R-GATE-CI-SETUP-RETRY the versions are arguments, so the workflow's pin is the only copy
